scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason: The confirmation lacks coffee and shipping charge details required by the checkpoint.
scenarios.diagnosis: The test expected information that the confirmation page was not required to show. The page confirms that the order is in and that €17.90 was charged, matching the bag total.
scenarios.suggestion: Update the final checkpoint to verify that the confirmation says the order is in and that €17.90 was charged. Only require an itemized coffee and shipping breakdown if that is an explicit product requirement.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag page.
After the items were added, shipping was €4.90 and the total was €49.40.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once.
The bag now shows free shipping and a total of €51.00.
